US Pauses Iran Strikes Amid Diplomatic Efforts and Regional Tensions

The United States has paused its strikes against Iran for a second night, following advice from top military officials who stated the campaign's effectiveness was limited and munitions stocks were dwindling. Diplomatic negotiations are ongoing to avoid further escalation. Iran also reported intercepting six ships in the Strait of Hormuz. Meanwhile, Saudi Arabia downed Iran-backed drones, and Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu was scheduled to meet with US President Trump to discuss Iran and Middle East security.
